film.title: ESCAPE VELOCITY
film.logline: A techwear fashion show where every Look is a Silicon Valley meme, walked by an AI model who is also a fashion model. A split-flap board counts down 18 MONTHS TO ESCAPE THE PERMANENT UNDERCLASS until it flips to THERE IS NO UNDERCLASS and the catwalk lifts off.
film.world: Blue-black night and steel blue, one red lamp as the only warm light, a colour halftone over everything, garment tags, split-flap boards and computer-vision boxes tracked to her. She wears look 00: a white cropped puff-sleeve shirt, a black pleated skirt in coated nylon with a harness belt and a hanging garment tag, black knee boots.

ESCAPE VELOCITY core sets shared by all three storyboards (lead generic for the identity pass)
ESCAPE VELOCITY: Waymo plates (waymo-back was refused by the identity pass: reclining, legs forward)
anabology: condition MJ on the face stylesheet via image references (Images slot) instead of GPT identity passes. Test: sheet 1 vs 3 vs both.
Face identity via Images slot, single-face crops from the character's face sheets 1 and 3 (the whole sheet imports its multi-head layout). Image weight test.

anabology: the character in a plain area at many distances, so MJ can place her far away at the right scale (single-face refs over-condition: big heads). Close/medium/full carry the face crops; wide/extreme-wide are text-only (far away the face matters less).
anabology flagged these 12 faces (MJ turns her Asian); regenerated with 'young Caucasian American woman, pale skin, light freckles'.
Plates of the winning (narrative) board that no existing pick covers; the lead as the director specified her: a young Caucasian American woman.
Merged storyboard plates not covered by an existing pick or alias.
anabology: shots near the end repeat one image (white-cu x8, gantries x7, takeoff x6); s058 backwards head. Real plates for stand-ins + variants.
